notes.title: Update 1.3 - Rematches Update
notes.content: [h1]Update 1.3 - Rematches Update[/h1][h2]New additions:[/h2][list][*][p]Added boss rematches![/p][list][*][p]Bosses can now be fought again after defeating them the first time[/p][/*][*][p]Activating the rematch requires a special item that is found in the Temple of Time[/p][/*][*][p]The rematch for every boss will be enabled after you defeat the subsequent boss[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added some lore in places that really needed some[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes:[/h2][list][*][p]Moved a heart in a bottle from the Temple of Time to the Lighthouse[/p][/*][*][p]Changed a puzzle in the Lighthouse to make it easier to understand[/p][/*][*][p]Some levers will now be pulled down by default and their function will be reversed[/p][list][*][p]This was done to make the function of levers more obvious[/p][/*][*][p]Eg. pulling a lever down => extract spikes, pulling a lever up => retract spikes[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Some arrow traps in the last dungeon are now slower[/p][/*][*][p]Added more checkpoints to the Enchanted Forest[/p][/*][/list][h2]Fixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Dialogues will no longer reference events that didn't actually happen[/p][list][*][p]Previosly, this could happen if you finished the game without completing some levels[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed one of the helper icons that appear after the end of the game being always visible[/p][/*][*][p]Stone doors now play a stone sound instead of a wood sound[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 1.2.2[/h1]

[h2]New additions:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added some indicators to tell you where some items you missed are.

[list]
[*] These indicators will appear on the world map after you have completed all levels and finished the game.
[*] They will point at levels that contain upgrades that you missed, such as hearts in a bottle, ingots, or quiver upgrades.
[*] They were introduced to help players to reach 100% completion after finishing the game.
[/list]

[*] Added some more skins.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed the secret jingle sound playing when not necessary in the Water Temple.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43905160/decf3fc5d7ee4807207605c5379971cd64d8560e.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.2.1[/h1]

[h2]New additions:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added yellow paint

[list]
[*] Yellow paint can be turned on from the accessibility settings
[*] When yellow paint is enabled, you will now see directions inside the level that will help you figure out what to do
[/list]
[*] Added colorblind filters

[list]
[*] Colorblind filters can be turned on from the accessibility settings
[*] Currently, the filter only applies to the hearts in the health bar and to "pick-up" hearts on the ground
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed some sound effects that got broken in the last update
[*] Fixed some secret jingles playing twice
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.2[/h1]

[h2]New additions[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added more information to the level completed screen.
[*] Added an aim indicator when using the bow.

[list]
[*] The aim indicator is off by default on PC and on by default on mobile.
[*] It can be toggled on and off in the game options.
[/list]
[/list]

[h2]Main changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Picking up the map or the spectral key from a chest now plays a sound.
[*] Levers that change the level of the lava in the Obsidian Fortress now always toggle between two levels.

[list]
[*] Previously, it was possible for the camera animation to play without the lava level actually changing.
[*] The level will now change every time the lever is flipped. 
[/list]
[*] General behind-the-scenes improvements and optimization.
[*] Fire traps now emit less light (and should be less laggy on low-end devices).
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed the level play time sometimes not being saved correctly.
[*] Fixed some special items not being reset after reloading a checkpoint.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.1[/h1]

[h2]Additions and changes[/h2]

[h3]Maps and compasses[/h3]

[list]
[*] Due to popular request, maps and compasses will now be preserved after completing a level.
[*] If you update your current save file, the game will consider that you already have a map and a compass in levels where you have found all chests.
[/list]

[h3]Health system[/h3]

[list]
[*] Traps, such as spikes and arrows, now deal 5 points of damage to enemies instead of 1.
[*] Bombs now deal 5 hearts of damage to the player instead of 10.
[*] Bombs now deal 25 points of damage to enemies instead of 10.
[/list]

[h3]Behaviour of enemies[/h3]

[list]
[*] When an enemy runs into a wall while the player is not in their line of sight, the will now stop chasing. This was done to prevent enemies from camping stairs.
[/list]

[h3]Checkpoints system[/h3]

[list]
[*] Significantly increased the number of checkpoints in every level.
[*] The game now shows an icon when a checkpoint is activated. This was added to let players know what has been saved.
[/list]

[h3]Skins[/h3]

[list]
[*] The price of most skins has been reduced.
[*] Added two new skins.
[/list]

[h3]Other changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] The Ancient Library has been almost completely redone.
[*] Camera animations are now based on distance instead of time. This means they should generally be smoother.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a spot in the cave of lights where it was possible to get stuck.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause the spacetime fabric to tear on very rare occasions.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused less bugs to appear.
[/list]

[h2]Addressing other feedback from the community[/h2]

[list]
[*] There is currently no plan to have an official Discord server. The previous server had to be deleted because it was being stormed by bots and scammers. Out of about 100 accounts who joined, only about 10 were controlled by real people. If the community wants to create an unofficial Discord server, they can, but as the only developer I don't want to be responsible for it.
[*] There is currently no plan for a console release. Console releases would slow down the development time quite significantly, delaying bug fixes and implementation of community feedback, and considering how the game was received at launch, this was the right decision.
[/list]

[h2]Thank you for listening![/h2]

I want to thank everyone for playing Ancient Mind! The launch went way beyond my expectations and I'm thrilled that so many people were interested.

If you want to report an issues or give feedback, use the community tab on Steam!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h1]Patch 1.0.1[/h1]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a spot in the first boss level where it was possible to get stuck.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause the player to freeze if the grappling hook was used too quickly against a wall.
[*] Fixed winged eye enemies not registering hits correctly. Previously you would hear the hit sound even though the enemy hadn’t actually been hit because it was not updating its hitbox correctly.
[*] Fixed a problem that would cause the player to be permanently stuck on the map screen if they quit the first level before finishing it.
[*] Fixed lights in the Dark Tunnels not properly resetting their “lit/unlit” state after the player respawned.
[/list]

Other minor changes:
[list]
[*] The sound of swinging the sword is now slightly lower.
[/list]

notes.title: Release date announcement!
notes.content:
Yes, Ancient Mind is releasing on the 19th of November at 5pm GMT / 6pm CET / 12pm EST / 9am PST!

After 3 years of working as a solo developer I can finally say that Ancient Mind has an official release date!

Working on this game has been the longest ant the best journey of my life and it fills me with joy to put that date up for the public!

There are already some content updates planned for the future, so stay tuned.

I should also mention that the demo has been deactivated, since it is outdated and no longer indicative of the complete game. If you have downloaded the demo previously you can still run it from your file system.

You can watch the latest trailer on the store page or here:

[previewyoutube=6PKnXqyhDOw;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Ancient Mind will be part of PixElated festival!
notes.content:
[h2]Thrilled to share that Ancient Mind will be part of [b]PixElatedFestival[/b]'s official selection![/h2]

[h3]Celebrate pixel-art games with us during the  Steam festival starting July 29th![/h3]

I said previously I wasn't going to update the demo anymore, but I guess  the plan changed!

This time I made sure there are no serious bugs, I changed the layout of a some of the dungeons, plus some minor differences. If you haven't played the Ancient Mind demo during Steam Next Fest in February, this will be your chance to recover what you've missed!

The updated version will be released short before the festival starts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43905160/d83c692d0e0791eec7a0ee678f04508db2d4b5ea.png[/img]

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Announcement
notes.content:
I’m proud to announce that Ancient Mind will partake in Steam Next Fest in February 2024!

There will be a new demo live for the event that will let you play the game up until the first boss.

Together with this announcement I’ve also published a new trailer showcasing the game that you’ll play for the event. Show your interest by sharing the trailer with your friends!

[previewyoutube=luqlCHRiCNg;full][/previewyoutube]

I also want to announce that I’m planning to release the game next year in Novemeber. If you want to be notified when that happens you can wishlist the game on Steam. This also helps to boost the game’s visibility and it’s the best thing you can do if you want to support the project.

I can’t wait to hear your feedback after the event!
